title: Quarterly Harmonization: Hosted Services Roadmap & Model Lineup
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Produce a reconciled, prioritized quarterly roadmap that aligns hosted inference feature work with the curated model lineup for Q2 2026. Scope includes decisions on which model variants to promote to Hosted API, phasing for deprecations, capacity & cost estimates tied to model choices, and concrete rollout milestones for SDK and Console changes. Deliverables: 1) Prioritized feature + model backlog for Q2; 2) Phasing document with capacity/cost deltas per model; 3) Rollout plan for SDK/Console + communication plan for customers. Stakeholders: PMs (Hosted API, Model Catalog), Eng (Serving runtime, Infra), Design (Console), Applied ML (model evals), Sales/CS for strategic customers. Success metrics: roadmap sign-off by stakeholders, estimated cost delta <= 8% vs baseline for planned model promotions, and clear rollout dates for at least 3 model promotions or variant rollbacks.
acceptance_criteria: Consolidated backlog with ranked tickets (features + model promotions) and owners
Quantified capacity and cost estimates for each prioritized model change
Signed-off rollout timeline with Console and SDK teams and at least one canary strategy defined
Communication brief for customers and support with deprecation timeline and fallback models
OKR mapping: every prioritized item mapped to an initiative or OKR with measurable success criteria
updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff meeting with serving runtime, applied ML, and console. Agreed to use eval harness from /drive/hosted-model-evals as single source for quality regressions.
2026-03-04: Initial model candidate list compiled (7 models). Applied ML provided A/B perf and quality deltas for baseline prompts. Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/q2-model-evals
2026-03-06: Capacity analysis requested from Infra; ENG asked to produce per-model GPU-hour estimates by 2026-03-09 (ENG-4891).

2026-03-08: Design reviewed proposed Console changes for model tagging and promoted a lightweight UX for model deprecation banners. Feedback: keep in-product notices contextual and link to release notes.

2026-03-10: PM review with Sales: three enterprise customers flagged for early beta; added customer communications task and support runbook. Decision: promote Model-B-lite to Hosted beta with canary traffic at 5%.
Next steps: finalize ranked backlog and circulation for stakeholder sign-off by 2026-03-15; schedule canary runbook creation with SRE by 2026-03-18.
attachments: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/412 - proposed sdk flags for model selection
notes: Trade-offs discussed: favoring slightly higher latency model with strong quality for search reranking customers vs lower-cost variant for high-throughput embedding workloads.
Risk: if infra capacity falls behind estimates, schedule fallback to smaller-quantized variants and update cost/OKR forecasts.
Follow-up: brief the exec team with a one-pager showing cost delta and customer impact before public announcement.
